shellCommands.command: git status --short && cat package.json && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^./.git/' | head -100

git diff package.json; for f in next.config.ts tsconfig.json lib/products.ts app/ProductGrid.tsx app/ProductSkeleton.tsx app/globals.css app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx "app/product/[slug]/page.tsx" __agent_eval__/run.mjs; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; echo; done
ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ && grep -ril "viewtransition\|view-transition\|view transition" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head -30 && cat node_modules/next/package.json | grep '"version"'

grep -n -B2 -A30 "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | head -80; echo ---; grep -rn -i "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/05-config/01-next-config-js/ 2>/dev/null | head; grep -n -i "view.transition" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md | head

grep -n "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -5; grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts | head -5; grep -n "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.d.ts | head; cat node_modules/@types/react/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/ | head; grep -c "ViewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.production.js
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "tsc exit: ${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; npx next build 2>&1 | tail -30

(npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf http://localhost:3123/ >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done; echo "--- / ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ | grep -o 'view-transition-name:[^;"]*' | sort -u; echo "--- /product/classic-sneakers ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3123/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o 'view-transition-name:[^;"]*' | sort -u; curl -s http://localhost:3123/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o '<main>.*' | head -c 400; echo; pkill -f "next start" ; git status --short

cat /tmp/next.log; (npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf http://localhost:3123/ >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done; curl -s http://localhost:3123/product/classic-sneakers > /tmp/detail.html; curl -s http://localhost:3123/ > /tmp/home.html; pkill -f "next start" || true; wc -c /tmp/home.html /tmp/detail.html; grep -o 'product-image-[a-z-]*' /tmp/home.html | sort -u; grep -o 'product-hero[^>]*>' /tmp/detail.html | head -2

npx next start -p 3123 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &
PID=$!
for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -sf http://localhost:3123/ >/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
curl -s http://localhost:3123/ > /tmp/home.html
curl -s http://localhost:3123/product/classic-sneakers > /tmp/detail.html
kill $PID
wc -c /tmp/home.html /tmp/detail.html
echo "--- home names ---"; grep -o 'view-transition-name:[^;"]*' /tmp/home.html | sort -u
echo "--- detail names ---"; grep -o 'view-transition-name:[^;"]*' /tmp/detail.html | sort -u
echo "--- detail main ---"; grep -o '<main>.\{0,300\}' /tmp/detail.html | head -1

grep -o '<main>.\{0,400\}' /tmp/home.html | head -1 | sed 's/<script.*//'; echo; echo ---; grep -o '<main>.\{0,500\}' /tmp/detail.html | head -1; echo; grep -c 'product-hero' /tmp/detail.html; grep -o 'skeleton-text[^"]*' /tmp/detail.html | sort | uniq -c
grep -o '<body>.\{0,700\}' /tmp/home.html | head -1; echo; echo ---; grep -o '<body>.\{0,700\}' /tmp/detail.html | head -1

cat .gitignore; git checkout tsconfig.json && sed -i 's|"include": \["next-env.d.ts", "\*\*/\*.ts", "\*\*/\*.tsx", ".next/types/\*\*/\*.ts"\]|"include": ["next-env.d.ts", "**/*.ts", "**/*.tsx", ".next/types/**/*.ts", ".next/dev/types/**/*.ts"]|' tsconfig.json && git diff tsconfig.json; rm -rf .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; git status --short
